title: How to Download a Proof of Early Termination Charges Bill Breakdown
content:
1. Go to sky.com/bill
2. Select view bill or view old bill for the required product(broadband, television or mobile)
3. Scroll down to download PDF, it has your name, address, account number and ETC
4. This does not normally work the MySky app or a mobile phone browser, you must use a PC

title: How to Fix a Sky Stream Puck Freezing
content:
1. Move the puck off the floor
2. Move the puck 30 inches
3. Move your router off the floor
4. Move your router 30 inches
5. Hold the reset button on the router for 30 sec, if there is no reset button hold the WPS button
6. Moved your booster off the floor
7. Unplug your booster
8. Call Sky UK 03442 411 411

title: How to fix WiFi dropping
content:
1. Move your router off the floor
2. Move your router 30 inches
3. Hold the reset button on the router for 30 sec, if there is no reset button hold the WPS button
4. Unplug your booster
5. Call Sky UK 03442 411 411
